prompt:
Photographic texture source for a photorealistic racing game set in Salwa, Kuwait, in 1985. Real photograph, not a render, not an illustration. Shot perfectly straight-on with a long lens so it reads as an orthographic elevation: no perspective, no vanishing lines, verticals perfectly vertical. Soft, even, shadowless daylight (bright overcast) so the game engine can add its own sun and shadows. True-to-life colours, fine surface detail: hairline cracks, dust, water stains, sun bleaching.

A long straight run of a 2.6 metre high boundary wall of a 1980s Kuwaiti villa, seen straight-on, filling the frame edge to edge left to right and from the pavement line at the bottom to the top of the wall at the top (no sky visible). Beige cement plaster with a band of rough yellow limestone cladding along the bottom metre, a white precast concrete coping along the top, dust and water stains, a few hairline cracks. The wall must continue seamlessly off both the left and right edges, no pillars, no gate, no doors.

Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermarks; people; cars; satellite dishes; modern LED lights or modern glass curtain walls; mosques, minarets, domes; flags; strong cast shadows; perspective distortion.
